holes.voiceTranscript: Friday evening solo round at Mize Elementary on freshly cut grass (Lindsey at dinner with friends, boys at Grandma & Grandpa's). Tested 170g Halo Star IT, Champion Firebird, and Star Mamba off the tee—Halo IT flew the farthest and cleanest ('So yeah, Mize 1 is IT!'). Overshot the 176g Glow Mako3 approach by 5–7 ft (note: use Star Sync from that range) and missed the XT Pig comebacker for Bogey 4 (+1).

Powered 176g Glow Mako3 dead-straight down the fairway ('That was awesome—a little high, but felt good!'). Switched from Mako3 to 175g Star Sync for the approach ('That was awesome! Great throw, great throw!') and tapped in for a clean Par 3 (+1)!

Form breakthrough on the tee: Halo Star IT went high & right, then tested Champion Firebird keeping the arm lower at a flat 90-degree angle and it went much farther! Threw a money 2nd shot with 174g DX Roc3 ('Beautiful, great one on the Roc3!') and also tested Glow Mako3 with a flat 90-degree swing across the chest. Finished with Bogey 4 (+2).

INSANE 150-FT THROW-IN BIRDIE 2! Left Firebird back on Hole 3, threw Halo Star IT off the tee (went left), retrieved Firebird, and then pulled 176g Glow Mako3 from ~150 feet out: 'Awesome! Right at the pin, right at the pin! I made it! I fucking made it! Made it straight in the pin from here—Two! Greatest shot ever! That felt like heaven!' Carded an unforgettable Birdie 2 (+1)!

Kept 170g Halo Star IT flatter off the tee ('That was good, not as high! Didn't go right and didn't go too far left—that flew its flight path!'). Pulled 175g Star Sync for the approach and clipped the fence, then threw Star Sync from 30 ft out and tapped in for Bogey 4 (+2).

Schoolhouse hole: Launched 172g Star Rollo off the tee ('That was fantastic—went high and slightly left!'). Followed with a standstill 152g Star Mamba 2nd shot under the tree ('Excellent, excellent! I was a standstill on that one, did not throw it too high, good line!'). Used 175g Star Sync for the uphill approach (so Aviar wouldn't fade left) for Bogey 4 (+3).

'IT time!' Aimed 170g Halo Star IT at the middle trees—clipped a tree but stayed low and still carried far! Kept 175g Star Sync low under a tree branch on the approach and drained the Par 3 putt with Star Sync ('Beauty! That was the IT and the Sync and the Sync!') for Par 3 (+3)!

Beautiful evening sky: Threw 152g Star Mamba solid and straight ('A little too high, but perfect where I wanted it to go—way farther than I thought!'). Followed with 175g Star Aviar through the center gap between the two trees and drained the Par putt with Star Aviar ('Par'd with the Aviar—Mamba -> Aviar -> Aviar!') for Par 3 (+3)!

389ft tree-line & road closer: Threw 170g Halo Star IT off the tee (faded left of the tree line away from the parked van), threw 152g Star Mamba on the 2nd shot (scuffed on the road), then threw a clutch uphill 3rd shot with 175g Star Sync right to the top of the hill 4–8 ft from the pin ('Beauty!') and tapped in for Bogey 4 to lock in a NEW MIZE ELEMENTARY PERSONAL BEST 31 (+4)!

history.roundTranscript: 10/23/26 Mize Elementary Friday Evening Solo Round (38:58, CALM) — NEW COURSE PERSONAL BEST 31 (+4), beating 32 (+5) from 10/20! Highlight of the night: Hole #4 (296ft) 150-FOOT THROW-IN BIRDIE 2 with 176g Glow Mako3 ('Right at the pin! I fucking made it! Greatest shot ever—that felt like heaven!'). Form breakthrough on Hole #3: keeping the throwing arm flat at a 90-degree angle across the chest prevents skying drivers high. H1: Tested Halo IT, Firebird & Mamba—Halo IT flew farthest ('Mize 1 is IT!'); Bogey 4. H2: Glow Mako3 tee drive + Star Sync parked approach for Par 3. H3: Flat 90-degree arm swing with Firebird & DX Roc3 ('Beautiful, great one on the Roc3!'); Bogey 4. H4: 150ft Glow Mako3 throw-in Birdie 2! H5: Flat Halo IT tee shot + Star Sync; Bogey 4. H6: Star Rollo tee drive + standstill Star Mamba 2nd shot + uphill Star Sync; Bogey 4. H7: Low Halo IT tee smash + low-ceiling Star Sync approach & putt for Par 3 ('Beauty! IT and the Sync and the Sync!'). H8: Star Mamba bombed off the tee + Star Aviar through the 2 trees & C1 putt for Par 3 (Mamba -> Aviar -> Aviar). H9: Halo IT tee drive + Star Mamba 2nd shot + uphill Star Sync 3rd shot parked to 4–8 ft for Bogey 4 and a new Course PB 31 (+4)!

holes.voiceTranscript: Swirling/gusty Kansas lunch-hour breeze: Chose 175g Star Sync off the tee instead of Aviar so the wind wouldn't lift it—almost aced it ('Almost hit the pin! That was nice!') and tapped in with Star Sync for an opening Birdie 2 (-1)!

Overruled the Firebird wind prompt ('Tells me the Firebird, but eff no, that thing goes too left!') and aimed 152g Star Mamba far right—stayed out of the left snake woods in birdie range! Birdie run with 175g Galactic XT Pig hit the side of the pin ('Right distance, right everything!'), tapped in Par 3 (-1).

Skipped Firebird again and pulled 152g Star Mamba ('Nice, nice, nice! Yeah, baby! That was beautiful, right there—perfect angle, perfect to the pin!'). Landed just past the basket and glided 175g Star Sync dead-center for Birdie 2 (-2)!

Switched from Firebird (which went too far yesterday) to 174g DX Roc3 off the tee ('At Roc3, that was the way! Great!'). Parked the green and buried the birdie putt with 175g Star Sync ('Keep practicing that guy—baby, baby, baby! Birdied this one!') for Birdie 2 (-3)!

3RD STRAIGHT BIRDIE! Pulled 176g Glow Mako3 ('A little safer and straighter with it—beautiful, beautiful, beautiful! Didn't go too far left, right there at the pin again!'). Parked to 5 feet and sunk it with 175g Star Sync to reach -4 thru 5!

Chose 176g Glow Mako3 off the tee ('Nice, a little far away for a bird though'). Chose heavier 175g Star Sync over Aviar in the wind for the long approach, clipped the guardian tree, and finished with 175g Galactic XT Pig for Bogey 4 (-3).

Trusted the verified 170g Champion I-Dye Firebird low skip/roll—curved left safely to ~30ft. Felt a wind gust pick up, switched from Sync to 175g Galactic XT Pig so the wind wouldn't lift it, and locked in a clean Par 3 (-3).
Passed on Firebird and pulled 170g Halo Star IT ('Damn, right there! Got a skip on it—I think it went right up to the basket!'). Drained the putt with 175g Star Sync for Birdie 2 (-4)!

'Rollo time, isn't it?' Threw 172g Star Rollo on the signature right-turning line, then drained a long bomb putt with 175g Galactic XT Pig ('Birdied that one! That was a far one away! That was my best one ever!') for a 4th consecutive H9 Birdie 2 and an ALL-TIME RECORD 22 (-5)!

history.roundTranscript: 10/23/26 Sar-Ko-Par Trails Lunch-Hour Solo Round (00:25:22 · Gusty/Swirling Kansas Wind): ALL-TIME PERSONAL BEST 22 (-5) with 6 Birdies (H1, H3, H4, H5, H8, H9), 2 Pars (H2, H7), and 1 Bogey (H6)! H1 (138ft): Chose 175g Star Sync off the tee in the wind—nearly aced it ('Almost hit the pin!') and tapped in Sync for Birdie 2 (-1). H2 (192ft): Overruled Firebird ('goes too left!') and aimed 152g Star Mamba right to stay out of the snake woods; 175g Galactic XT Pig birdie bid grazed the side of the pin for Par 3 (-1). H3 (162ft): Laced 152g Star Mamba ('Beautiful, right there—perfect angle, perfect to the pin!') + glided 175g Star Sync in for Birdie 2 (-2). H4 (162ft): Switched to 174g DX Roc3 off the tee ('At Roc3, that was the way!') + buried 175g Star Sync putt for Birdie 2 (-3). H5 (144ft): Piped 176g Glow Mako3 dead-straight to 5ft ('Beautiful, beautiful, beautiful!') + Star Sync tap-in for 3rd straight Birdie 2 (-4). H6 (165ft): Glow Mako3 tee shot + Star Sync clipped guardian tree + XT Pig for Bogey 4 (-3). H7 (139ft): Low 170g Champion Firebird roll to 30ft + wind-fighting 175g Galactic XT Pig approach for Par 3 (-3). H8 (171ft): Skipped 170g Halo Star IT right up to the basket ('Damn, right there!') + Star Sync Birdie 2 (-4). H9 (141ft): 'Rollo time!' Curved 172g Star Rollo right and drained a deep bomb putt with 175g Galactic XT Pig ('That was my best one ever!') to finish 22 (-5)!

holes.voiceTranscript: Day 3 in a row at Sar-Ko-Par (solo round): Threw 175g Star Aviar right at the 138ft pin—felt nice and sailed ~10ft past the basket. 175g Star Sync birdie putt hit the top band, tapped in for Par 3. Requested a clear indicator badge for Jeffery's verified best disc on each hole.

Chose 176g Glow Mako3 over Roc3 so it flies straight without fading left into the snake woods ('Beautiful, beautiful, beautiful!'). Used 175g Star Aviar for the approach with the new grip tip—keeping the index finger out of the way on the rim—and nearly threw it in for an easy Par 3!
Threw 152g Star Mamba off the tee—flew a bit too far past the 162ft basket. 175g Star Sync birdie bid rolled slightly long, made the comeback putt for Par 3.

Tried 174g DX Roc3 off the tee and hit an early tree; threw 176g Glow Mako3 second shot, then tested both 175g Star Sync (low) and 175g Galactic XT Pig (high, identical distance) on the approach before tapping in for Bogey 4.

BIRDIE 2! Piped 176g Glow Mako3 dead-straight just left of the guardian tree ('Didn't flick the wrist, felt good!'). Stepped up with 175g Star Sync and buried the birdie putt ('Got a birdie with the Sync—hell yes!') to get back to Even Par!

Pulled the purple/green 170g Halo Star IT left into the tree line toward the water—spotted it safely dry much farther down than expected! Pitched out with 175g Star Aviar and missed the par save for Bogey 4.

Threw 170g Champion I-Dye Firebird low with a good forward roll. Long birdie look with 175g Star Sync missed left, then drained a smooth, floaty 175g Star Aviar comeback putt ('That felt great—floated nicely right in!') for Par 3.

152g Star Mamba tee shot clipped the trees. Threw two practice drives with 170g Champion Firebird and 170g Halo Star IT—both flew clean and way better than the Mamba! Played the original Mamba lie honestly for Bogey 4.

'Rollo time!' Threw 172g Star Rollo on the signature right-turning curve and parked it 5 feet left of the pin ('Look at that—right there at the hole, 5 feet to the left!'). Tapped in for Birdie 2 to finish 28 (+1)!

history.roundTranscript: 10/22/26 Sar-Ko-Par Trails Solo Round (Day 3 in a row · 00:32:56 · Calm): Jeffery 28 (+1) with 2 Birdies (H5, H9) & 4 Pars! Piped Glow Mako3 dead-straight left of center tree (zero wrist flick) and drained 175g Star Sync putt! holes.voiceTranscript: 292ft Uphill Opener: Jeffery threw 170g Halo Star IT high into the trees, 2nd shot with 176g Glow Mako3, and 3rd/putt with 175g Star Sync for 4. Jack bombed a gorgeous tee shot ('Look at that, it's beautiful!') and matched with a 4. Note: Requested Caddie Trio always show 1. Driver, 2. Mid-Range, 3. Putter.

320ft Park Fairway: Jeffery threw 152g Star Mamba off tee (clipped tree), then shaped 172g Star Rollo down the right tree line away from parkgoers, and finished with 175g Star Sync for 4. Jack took a 5. Note: Requested adding 'Last Round' score alongside Avg and Best in the Hole History bar.

225ft (Fixed from silly Par 2 to Par 3!): Jeffery threw 170g Halo Star IT off tee, 2nd shot with 175g Star Sync came up short (noted 175g Galactic XT Pig is better for that approach), and tapped in for 4. Jack threw all 3 Discraft discs (Cicada, Buzzz SS, Roach) for a 4.

225ft Wooded Line: Used the Dynamic Discs Retriever telescoping hook to rescue a disc from the ivy! Jeffery threw 152g Star Mamba off tee (skipped off tree), 172g Star Rollo 2nd shot (clipped tree), then a clutch 176g Glow Mako3 recovery ('Awesome with the Mako!') for 4. Jack carded a 5.

247ft Play-Through Hole: A group of ~20 players let Jeffery & Jack play through! Jeffery threw 170g Halo Star IT off tee, then laced a money 2nd shot with 174g DX Roc3 right up to the pin ('Awesome shot on the Roc3—great disc!') and dropped in 175g Galactic XT Pig for a clean Par 3! Jack took a 4.

160ft Downhill Green (Fixed to Par 3): Jeffery threw 176g Glow Mako3 off tee, then chose 175g Galactic XT Pig from 30ft on the downhill slope so it would sit and stop without rolling away ('Going with the Pig, because it stops!') for Par 3. Jack piped a dead-straight tee shot down the fairway and finished with 4.

190ft DOUBLE BIRDIE HOLE (Fixed to Par 3!): Jeffery pulled 172g Star Rollo off the tee and rolled it all the way down by the pin ('Look at that Rollo go! Rolled all the way down there by the pin!'), then tapped in with 175g Galactic XT Pig for Birdie 2! Jack ALSO parked his tee shot right by the basket ('Oh, beauty, Jack! Look at that!') and drained his putt for a twin Birdie 2!

198ft Right-Shaping Line (Fixed to Par 3): Jeffery threw 172g Star Rollo off tee to curve right, navigated the trees with 176g Glow Mako3, and finished with 175g Star Aviar for 4. Jack matched with a solid 4.

235ft Closer: Jeffery's 176g Glow Mako3 tee shot hit a tree dead-on, scrambled low around the trees with 172g Star Rollo, pitched up with 175g Star Sync, and rimmed out the 4-putt for a 5. Jack crushed the closer for a clean Par 3 to finish 35 (+8) to Jeffery's 33 (+6)!

H4 (225ft): Rescued disc from ivy with Dynamic Discs Retriever hook; Jeffery Mako3 scramble for 4, Jack 5. Jeffery rolled 172g Star Rollo all the way to the pin + XT Pig tap-in for 2; Jack parked his drive right by the pin for Birdie 2! H8 (198ft): Both scored 4s using Rollo/Mako3/Aviar. holes.voiceTranscript: Calm lunch-break solo round: Trusted the Caddie Rec and threw 175g Star Aviar straight at the 138ft pin—almost aced it ('That hit the pin, dude, just about, that was beautiful!') for a tap-in Birdie 2! Note: Requested showing all 3 recommended discs on every hole and a 1-tap Solo toggle to remove Jack.

Tested 174g DX Roc3 aiming right, hyzered into the left woods (near the old snake spot). Threw a 2nd test tee shot with 176g Glow Mako3 and parked it ('Mako3 on Hole 2, Sar-Ko-Par is the way to go!'). Played original Roc3 lie honestly out of the woods with 175g Galactic XT Pig to 15ft and drained the Par 3 putt!

Tried DX Roc3 with a 90-degree elbow, curved left short. Threw 152g Star Mamba on the exact same line and parked the pin ('Mamba would've been the one—that's right there at the frigging pin! Mamba on Hole 3, that's the way to do it!'). Carded Par 3.

Pulled 170g Champion I-Dye Firebird to curve left at the end—sliced right through the gap to inside 10ft ('Look at that... less than 10 feet away from the hole!'). Drained the birdie putt with 175g Galactic XT Pig for Birdie 2 (-2)! Requested removing Skins/Match Play buttons and fixing timer pause.

Laced 176g Glow Mako3 dead-straight just left of the guardian tree ('Dead straight, just to the left of the tree, it's in birdie range!'). First birdie run with XT Pig hit low cage and rolled 10ft; second try with Star Sync clipped top band; tapped in for Par 3.
135ft walk-up: Threw 170g Halo Star IT ('Good, beauty, beauty, right to the hole... fantastic!'). Missed the birdie putt hitting the bucket/top with Star Sync & XT Pig, tapped in for Par 3.

Low-hanging branch ceiling: Threw 170g Champion I-Dye Firebird low under the branch to fade left into the dirt bullseye (~12ft)! Buried the putt with 175g Galactic XT Pig for FIRST-EVER BIRDIE 2 on Hole 7 ('Pretty excited about my first birdie on 7!') to reach -3!

189ft play with water behind pin: Threw 170g Champion I-Dye Firebird low under the tree; clipped the tree but deflected safely left & dry. Pitched 175g Star Sync right under the basket for a stress-free Par 3.

Went back to the signature 172g Star Rollo ('Rollo always on number nine!'): Threw a smooth right-turning curve right at the basket to 6ft ('Look at that... 6 feet past the basket, parked it!') and drained the birdie putt to finish 23 (-4)!

holes.voiceTranscript: Dead-calm wind ('6 mph forecast is lying to us!'): Jeffery parked Halo IT to 10ft ('went right up to the pin, dude!') and buried Star Sync for Birdie 2! Jack solid Par 3.
Up & over the hill: Jeffery Halo IT landed left in the fairway + Star Sync for a safe Par 3; Jack dialed his Discraft Roach putter approach ('look at that putter shot!') for Par 3.

Moon getting brighter & brighter: Jeffery striped Glow Mako3 dead-straight down the fairway ('Flat, perfect, excellent on the Mako3!') for Par 3 while chatting with Jack about visiting the St. Louis Arch. Jack 4.
Jack wins Hole 4 with a Par 3! Jack's yellow Cicada skipped low & clean to the green for 3, while Jeffery clipped a tree and hit the top of the basket pan for Bogey 4 (getting Back to Even).
Right-curving dogleg: Jeffery pulled Star Rollo ('going for Rollo because this is the hole that goes to the right'), curved past the tree into the open, and both carded Par 3s!
Dark in the woods: Jeffery threw Star Rollo ('flying good, hit a tree'), decided no more 2-disc throws in the dark so nothing gets lost, and saved Par 3! Jack 4.
Tight orange trees corridor: Jeffery saved Par 3 through the trees; Jack's drive was cooking before a tree kick stopped it for 5.

Jeffery crushed Star Rollo ('tilted over good—could have been the farthest I've thrown on this hole!'), then used Galactic XT Pig to prevent a roll-away on the sloped green for Par 3. Jack threw a very good one for Par 3!
Almost too dark to see ('bananas!'): Jeffery laced Glow Mako3 dead-straight just right of the guardian tree, and both drained Par 3s in the dark to lock in Jeffery's Even-Par 27 (E) & Jack's 31!

holes.voiceTranscript: Calm wind under the moon! Jeffery Halo IT tee + Star Aviar approach for Par 3. Jack bombed Cicada off the tee and threw Buzzz SS (skipped out of basket) for 4.
Both drives landed exact same distance (Jack's Cicada skipped down the trail). Jeffery used Star Sync ('goes straight') and both poured in Par 3s!
Jeffery Halo IT hyzer smacked the sign right where it needed to stop, then drained a 25–30ft Star Sync putt ('Three, baby! Beautiful—beat my last score by two!'). Jack 4.

Throwing into the sun: Jeffery Halo IT drawn toward the woods ('like a magnet'), dodged a huge thorn that almost went through his shoe, ran back for a forgotten disc, both carded Bogey 4s (Jack beat his previous H5 score!).
Front side of Mize Elementary school: Jeffery shaped Star Mamba safely around the left side of the school + long Star Aviar approach for 4; Jack stayed on the good side for 4.
Jack wins Hole 7 with a Par 3! Jeffery Halo IT made it over the road ('do your S thing'), tried Star Rollo right-curve around a tree, and hit the pole just low on the par try for 4.
Downhill 235ft: Jeffery threw Halo IT flat & straight ('That was fantastic—left, straight out, not too high!') and parked Star Sync to 5ft for Par 3. Jack threw a beautiful straight Buzzz SS drive.

Long 389ft closer by the soccer field: Jeffery Mamba tee + neat open-field DX Roc3 shot, fought through a glute charley horse ('Charlie horse in my butt!') to finish with 5 at 6:24 PM before heading to Black Hoof!

bag.name: Aviar
bag.moldAndFlight: Foundational beadless putter with a palm-filling profile. Dead straight inside the circle with a subtle low-speed finish.
bag.courseStrategy: Circle 1 & Circle 2 chains hunter, plus soft touch approaches (100–150 ft) that settle flat at the pole.
bag.personalFlightNotes: Flew dead straight on normal full throws ('Went definitely straight—I thought it would go more left on me!'). Best accuracy from 12–15 ft and 12-step (~36 ft) putts with index finger tucked OFF the rim.
bag.transcriptStats: 10/23 Mize Field Test & Round: Drained 12–15ft & 36ft practice putts ('Aviar was the best there!') + Mize H8 Par 3 (Mamba -> Aviar -> Aviar). 10/21-10/22 Sar-Ko-Par: 2× H1 Birdies!
bag.caddieRoleNote: Circle 1/2 Putt (Index Finger Off Rim) & Straight Touch Approach

bag.name: Sync
bag.moldAndFlight: Low-profile Star throwing putter at max 175g weight built to handle full-power tee shots without wobbling or burning over.
bag.courseStrategy: Dead-straight tunnel tee shots, L→R crosswind approaches, uphill pin runs, or long putts outside Circle 2 (120–195 ft).
bag.personalFlightNotes: Glides farthest of all 3 putters ('Sync is beautiful—too far! Best of them was the Sync!'). Holds a laser-straight line without fading left on uphill approaches, so dial power to 80% inside 150 ft so it doesn't sail long.
bag.transcriptStats: 10/23 Doubleheader MVP: Nearly aced windy Sar-Ko-Par H1 for Birdie 2, parked Mize H2 & H7 for Par 3s, parked Mize H9 uphill 3rd shot to 4–8ft, and won the Mize 3-putter distance test!
bag.caddieRoleNote: 175g Star Sync — #1 Throwing Putter, Uphill Pin Parker & Windy H1 Ace Runner

bag.name: Pig (F2)
bag.moldAndFlight: Thick, blunt rim featuring a recessed Thumbtrack for backhand and forehand grip. Refuses to float long in Kansas winds, dumping left.
bag.courseStrategy: Forehand flick approaches inside 200 feet, headwind/crosswind upshots, and death putts where sailing long is OB.
bag.personalFlightNotes: On full throws, tracks left and drops fast ('Pig: Left, drops!')—never sails long like Sync. Inside 10–15 ft, hits chains heavy and dead-center ('10–12 feet away, 15, yep, got it!'). Aim slightly right of target on longer throws.
bag.transcriptStats: 10/23 Sar-Ko-Par & Mize Field Test: Drained windy Sar-Ko-Par H7 & H9 Birdie putts + buried 12–15ft Mize twilight putts! 10/21 Harmon H6: Stopped dead on downhill green.
bag.caddieRoleNote: 175g Galactic XT Pig — Left-Drop Brake Brick & Windy C1 Chains Finisher

bag.name: Rollo
bag.moldAndFlight: Wide-diameter midrange with a smooth rounded rim designed for effortless right-turning glide and instant ground rollers.
bag.courseStrategy: Get-out-of-jail scramble disc. Ideal for awkward stances in the woods, right-turning doglegs, and easy backhand rollers.
bag.personalFlightNotes: 10/23 MIZE 9-DISC DISTANCE WINNER! Your natural RHBH hyzer tilt flips the Rollo up into a gorgeous mini S-curve ('Almost did a tiny S—right, then fought back left! Farthest was the Rollo, best shot of them all!'). Finishes right of center with +10–15 ft extra glide.
bag.transcriptStats: 10/23 Mize Field Test #1 Farthest Shot ('Tiny S-curve, best shot of them all!') + Mize H6 tee bomb + 4-for-4 Sar-Ko-Par H9 Birdie Machine (10/21, 10/22 & 10/23)!
bag.caddieRoleNote: 172g Star Rollo — #1 Field-Test Distance S-Curve Mid & H9 Birdie Lock

bag.name: Mako3
bag.moldAndFlight: Flat-topped, wide-diameter, and beadless for a clean release. Zero turn and zero fade hold your exact release angle to the ground.
bag.courseStrategy: Tight wooded hallways with zero room to drift left or right, flat crosswind lines, and long 150 ft throw-in runs.
bag.personalFlightNotes: 10/23 MIZE STRAIGHT DISTANCE KING! Out-flew all other straight mids and fairway drivers by 10–15 feet on the left-center line ('Mako3 is the best—it went the farthest, 10–15 ft further ahead!'). Keep arm at 90° chest level with zero wrist flick.
bag.transcriptStats: 10/23 Mize Hole #4 150-FT THROW-IN BIRDIE 2 ('Right at the pin! I fucking made it! Greatest shot ever!') + #1 Straight Mid in Mize 9-disc field test + 2× Sar-Ko-Par H5 Birdies!
bag.caddieRoleNote: 176g Glow Mako3 — 150ft Throw-In Legend & #1 Straight Distance Mid

bag.name: Roc3
bag.moldAndFlight: Faster, flatter evolution of the classic beaded Roc. At 174g, delivers a straight push with a strong late left fade in the breeze.
bag.courseStrategy: Stock open-fairway midrange shots requiring a dependable left finish in headwinds and R→L crosswinds.
bag.personalFlightNotes: Feels great off the fingers ('That was a fun one to throw—felt good off the fingers!'), but because of its 3 fade + your natural hyzer tilt, it finishes 10–15 ft shorter than Mako3/Rollo. Best for controlled 150–210 ft wind approaches.
bag.fieldTestRank: Clean Finger Release · Controlled Mid Tier
bag.transcriptStats: 10/23 Doubleheader: Parked windy Sar-Ko-Par H4 tee shot to 12ft for Birdie 2 ('Nice throw!') + striped Mize H3 2nd shot ('Beautiful, great one on the Roc3!').
bag.caddieRoleNote: 174g DX Roc3 — Clean-Release Breeze Mid & Sar-Ko-Par H4 Birdie Ace

bag.name: Halo IT
bag.moldAndFlight: Rounded convex bottom wing feels as comfortable as a midrange. Thrown on a slight hyzer, pops flat and glides along a tight S-curve.
bag.courseStrategy: Primary wooded fairway driver, effortless 70%-power placement shots, and Mize #1, #5, #7 & #9 tee drives.
bag.personalFlightNotes: Easiest driver for you to keep low with minimal right-side-up tilt ('Not as high. Good. Not as much tilt either!'). Finishes on the left side of the fairway group, ~10 ft behind Mamba/Mako3 when thrown slightly nose-up.
bag.transcriptStats: 10/23 Doubleheader: Parked windy Sar-Ko-Par H8 for Birdie 2, won Mize H1 3-driver shoot-off ('Mize 1 is IT!'), striped flat H5 tee shot & low H7 drive for Par 3!
bag.caddieRoleNote: 170g Halo Star IT (SPD 7) — Lowest-Tilt Fairway Workhorse (Mize #1/#5/#7 & Sar-Ko-Par #8)

bag.name: Firebird
bag.moldAndFlight: Blunt nose, flat profile, and comfortable 1.9 cm rim. In durable Champion plastic, its 3 glide and 4 fade laugh at 30 mph headwinds.
bag.courseStrategy: Heavy headwinds, low-ceiling left-fade skips (Sar-Ko-Par H4, H7, H8), L→R crosswinds, and flat 90°-arm drives.
bag.personalFlightNotes: If released high with right-side-up tilt, its 4 fade dumps hard left early. When you swing your arm lower at a flat 90° chest angle ('Lower, kept it more flat!'), it punches much straighter and lands center-pack! Hardest disc to spot at dusk.
bag.transcriptStats: 10/23 Doubleheader: Parked windy Sar-Ko-Par H7 to 12ft for Birdie 2 + unlocked 90° flat chest swing breakthrough on Mize H3! (Spotter Alert: Watch closely at dusk!).
bag.caddieRoleNote: 170g Champ Firebird — 90°-Flat-Arm Wind Fighter & Sar-Ko-Par H7 Birdie Specialist
bag.spotterWarning: Dusk & Leaf Alert: Tie-Dye Champion plastic camouflages in grass & shadows—always watch it all the way to the ground!

bag.name: Mamba
bag.moldAndFlight: Pairing -5 high-speed turn with a featherlight 152g Star weight creates effortless distance. Released on a hyzer, stands up and glides forever.
bag.courseStrategy: Max-distance drives, Sar-Ko-Par H2 (stays right of left woods!) & H3 pin runs, Mize H6 standstill 2nd shots, and Mize H8 tee bombs.
bag.personalFlightNotes: 10/23 #1 DRIVER DISTANCE! Even when released with your natural right-side-up hyzer tilt, its -5 turn & 152g weight counteracts the tilt so it stands up and bombs 10–15 ft past Halo IT and Firebird ('Mamba went farther!'). Keep low—skying it robs distance.
bag.transcriptStats: 10/23 Doubleheader & Field Test: #1 farthest driver in Mize field test, bombed Mize H8 tee shot for Par 3, crushed standstill Mize H6 2nd shot, and stayed out of Sar-Ko-Par H2 left woods!
bag.caddieRoleNote: 152g Star Mamba (SPD 11) — #1 Distance Driver (Counters Natural Hyzer Tilt!)
bag.spotterWarning: Throw low & flat or standstill (like Mize H6)—skying it high stalls its -5 turn!

bag.name: Roach
bag.moldAndFlight: Jack's main beadless putter and short approach disc. Straight, floaty profile that aims dead at the chains with a soft landing.
bag.courseStrategy: Jack's Circle 1 & Circle 2 putting putter plus straight touch approaches inside 175 ft.
bag.personalFlightNotes: Jack's beadless C1/C2 chain magnet—glides straight with minimal fade.
bag.transcriptStats: 10/19: Drained 3 consecutive birdies on Art Nine H3, H4, H5 for a career PB 24 (-3)! Nailed longest career putt on Black Hoof H7.

bag.name: Buzzz SS
bag.moldAndFlight: Jack's smooth point-and-shoot ESP midrange. Effortless hyzer-flip to flat flight with a gentle right drift and clean finish.
bag.courseStrategy: Jack's workhorse midrange for 175–255 ft fairways, wooded gaps, and controlled turnovers.
bag.personalFlightNotes: Jack's dead-straight fairway carver—flips flat and glides down wooded corridors.
bag.transcriptStats: 10/20 Mize: Striped H4 & H8 fairways ('Beautiful straight shot down the fairway, Jack, on the Buzzz!'). 10/19: Clutch 3 on Black Hoof H8.

bag.name: Cicada
bag.moldAndFlight: Jack's high-glide 7-speed fairway driver. Holds a laser-straight line off the tee with massive 6 glide and minimal fade.
bag.courseStrategy: Jack's primary driver on holes 235+ ft and long Par 3 / Par 4 tee shots.
bag.personalFlightNotes: Jack's max-distance fairway bomber—huge 6 glide and big skips off hardpack.
bag.transcriptStats: 10/20 Mize: Won 324ft H7 outright with a Par 3, skipped down H2 trail for Par 3 & skipped 20ft off the H9 curb! 10/19: Striped Black Hoof H1 ('one of the best throws ever!').
